notes: B2 analysis on top of B1's stacks (data/processed) and cached exposures (data/raw). Difference images: k*B - A on B1's common grid; colour range shared per detector (blue = fainter/old position, red = brighter/new position). Their target residual is NOT a variability measurement: each epoch samples different wavelengths inside a detector (see caveats). Light curves: forced aperture photometry (r = 2 px) on every exposure, corrected for the spectral shape inside each detector; fluxes in mJy; variability significance uses a 3% systematic floor. Flags: saturated = core lost, flux is a lower limit; contaminated = >20% of the aperture masked or flagged; blended = another source in the aperture.
